traits.name: Pack Tactics.
traits.text: The thug has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the thug's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack.
actions.text: The thug makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Mace.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow.
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
